concern_results.conclusion: init_surface_state drops slash_commands/terminal_slash_commands/skills/plugins from every verdict set on both parse paths (skipped before the metadata-container check, kept in known_fields) while mcp_servers alone stays required-empty and tools/tool_use/permissionMode verdicts keep their classes; all six-tuple unpack sites and the retired parser options are updated consistently with the acceptance flip.

The invocable surface is still pinned by the exact tools allowlist, the tool_use scan, an empty mcp_servers list and the pinned permissionMode; --plugin-dir is gated on registry verification plus a skills-only manifest check that rejects hooks/commands/agents/mcpServers by key presence, so no executable surface is newly loaded.

Verifier failure, stale or missing registry, unloadable plugin and absent --plugin-dir now degrade to native_skill_binding=unavailable with a stderr note instead of aborting, while missing --safe-mode, missing tool-restriction flags and owner-args-without-profile keep their terminal classes, and the plugin path resolution is guarded under set -e.

The 270-case matrix runs every row through both parse paths with real 2.1.261 vocabulary fixtures, the mutation walk detects drop-mcp-empty, vocabulary-as-breach and vocabulary-as-drift mutants plus the four pre-existing ones, and the wrapper/gate suites assert the receipt value, the absence of --plugin-dir in argv and exactly one model invocation.

review_gate.py accepting unavailable is additive for wrappers that never emit it, removed parser options exit 64 loudly for stale callers, the retired unclassifiable-vocabulary routing arm matches the parser's retired phrase, and Kimi/Codex/OpenCode wrappers are untouched.

No stored state, migration or persistent artifact changes; rollback is reinstalling the self-contained prior wrapper, with the 0.15.0 version pointer, register row and docs updates carried by mechanical repo gates per evidence since those files sit outside this bounded diff.

A degraded run is visible via the wrapper stderr note, the native_skill_binding=unavailable receipt in the payload, and the gate's skill_usage_evidence mode controller-profile with reviewed_skills empty unless the receipt is established; remaining refusal reasons keep their enumerated detail fields.

The shared gate's trust boundary (tools, tool_use, mcp_servers, permissionMode) is unchanged and asserted beside every vocabulary shape including embedded routing phrases, which can no longer reach any routed reason string; the removed name-snapshot judging only ever chose which client served the review, never whether an unverified surface was accepted.
